unitTitle: The Shark Caller - Episode 1: The Curse
scanNote:
1-HIKOYA, 1-QISMNING MASHQLARI (25-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'The Shark Caller - Episode 1'.

CHAP USTUN:
1) 'Look at the pictures, then read the sentences and circle the correct item.' Beshta gap, har birida a, b, c variantlari.
2) 'Look at the pictures, then answer the questions. Write S for Sandra, D for David or Se for Senan.' Beshta savol, o'ngda nuqtali joy.
3) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and write S for Sandra, D for David or Se for Senan.' Beshta gap.
4) 'Read the episode and answer the questions.' Beshta savol.
5) 'Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: ask, call, coconut, get, go, look, sweet, shark. Ikki ustunda 8 nuqtali qator.

O'NG USTUN:
• Och yashil-ko'k ramkali quti: 'Expressing Certainty' sarlavhasi bilan. Ikki band; misollar TO'Q SARIQ QIYA harflarda.
6) 'Look at the pictures and the prompts, then make sentences with must or can't, as in the example.' O'ng tomonda TO'RTTA SURAT va oq yorliqlar: kokos yong'og'i ('coconut - pineapple'), tezyurar qayiq ('speedboat - canoe'), kartoshka ('potato - doughnut'), delfin ('dolphin - shark'). Chapda ko'k qiya namuna: "It must be a coconut. It can't be a pineapple."
7) 'Fill in must or can't.' Beshta gap.
8) a) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Put the events into the correct order, then listen and check your answers. Finally, tell the story.' Yettita gap, har birining oldida bo'sh KATAKChA; beshinchisida ALLAQAChON '1' yozilgan.
   b) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen again, then take roles and act out the episode.'
• Och yashil-ko'k ramkali quti: 'Will' sarlavhasi bilan; misol to'q sariq qiya harflarda.
9) 'What do you think will happen in the next episode? Make predictions with will, as in the example.' Ko'k qiya namuna: 'I think the shark will attack them.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '25'.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then read the sentences and circle the correct item.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng gaplarni o'qing va to'g'ri variantni aylantiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR KOMIKSDA BOR.

  ⚠ Har savol bitta kadrga tegishli -
  rasmga va gap pufakchasiga qarang.


⚠ 'A VILLAGE', 'A TOWN', 'A CITY':

  a village - qishloq (eng kichik)
  a town    - shaharcha
  a city    - katta shahar

  ⚠ Kirish matnida aynan 'the VILLAGE
  of Kontu' deyilgan.


⚠ 'A HUT', 'A FLAT', 'A COTTAGE':

  a hut     - kulba (oddiy, somon yoki
              yog'ochdan)
  a flat    - kvartira
  a cottage - qishloqdagi kichik uy
              (mustahkam, g'ishtdan)

  ⚠ Senan 3-kadrda: 'My HUT is this way.'


⚠ 'A BOWL OF ...':

  = bir kosa ...
  ⚠ 4-kadrda idishda ovqat ko'rinadi.
  Senan aytadi: 'You must eat only
  SWEET POTATOES.'

items.whyUz:
⚠ Kirish matnida: 'the VILLAGE of Kontu in the
South Pacific'.
⚠ 1-kadrda somon tomli kulbalar va dengiz
ko'rinadi.
⚠ 'BY the sea' = dengiz bo'yida.

⚠ Kirish matnida: 'the story of A MAN, Senan'.
⚠ 'to look FOR' = qidirmoq (predlog 'for').

items.textEn: 3  The man takes them to his ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 3-kadrda Senan aytadi: 'My HUT is this way.'
⚠ 'a hut' = somon yoki yog'och kulba.

items.textEn: 4  The man gives them a bowl of ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ 4-kadrda Senan aytadi: 'You must eat only
SWEET POTATOES.'
⚠ 'a bowl of' = bir kosa.

items.textEn: 5  The man beats the water with coconut ___ .
items.whyUz:
⚠ Oxirgi kadrda: 'He's beating the water with
coconut SHELLS.'
⚠ 'a shell' = qobiq.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures, then answer the questions. Write S for Sandra, D for David or Se for Senan.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang, so'ng savollarga javob bering. Sandra uchun S, Devid uchun D, Senan uchun Se yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMDAGI UCh QAHRAMON:

  SANDRA - sariq (fair) uzun sochli,
     yashil ko'zli ayol
  DAVID  - qora, kalta, tekis sochli
     erkak
  SENAN  - to'q tanli, ajinli qora tanli
     erkak


⚠ TAShQI QIYoFA SO'ZLARI - 6 va
8-BETLARDAN:

  fair hair - oq-sariq soch
  a dark complexion - to'q yuz rangi
  straight hair - tekis soch
  wrinkles - ajinlar

  ⚠ Bu so'zlar 1-unitning 12-mashqidagi
  jadvalda o'rganilgan edi - bu yerda
  ular QAYTA ishlatilyapti.


⚠ "WHO'S GOT ...?":

  = kimning ... bor?
  ⚠ To'liq: 'Who HAS got ...?'
  ⚠ Britaniya egaligi ('have got').

  ⚠ Javob: 'Sandra has' yoki qisqa
  belgi bilan 'S'.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Rasmda Sandra - sariq uzun sochli.
⚠ 'fair hair' = oq-sariq soch (8-betdagi
jadvalda).

⚠ Senan - qora tanli.
⚠ 'a complexion' = yuz/teri rangi
(6-betdagi 1-mashqda ham bor edi).

⚠ Rasmda Sandraning ko'zlari yashil.
⚠ 'eyes' - HAR DOIM KO'PLIKDA tasvirlanadi.

pairs.left: 4  Who's got short straight black hair?
pairs.leftUz: Kimning sochi kalta, tekis va qora?
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ SIFATLAR TARTIBI: short (uzunlik) →
straight (shakl) → black (rang) → hair.
⚠ 20-betdagi qoida bo'yicha.

⚠ Senan - kattaroq odam, yuzida ajinlar bor.
⚠ 2-kadrda: 'Senan must be the OLDER man.'

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and write S for Sandra, D for David or Se for Senan.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va Sandra uchun S, Devid uchun D, Senan uchun Se yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
JAVOBLAR KOMIKSDA BOR.

  ⚠ Kassetada shu epizod o'qiladi -
  mashqni AUDIOSIZ ham bajarish mumkin:
  har gapning qaysi pufakchada
  ekanini toping.


⚠ QAYSI GAP KIMNIKI:

  1  "No, it can't be him." - 2-kadrdagi
     SANDRA ning pufakchasi
  2  "He's got marks on his arms." -
     2-kadrdagi DAVID ning pufakchasi
  3  'You must prepare for tomorrow.' -
     4-kadrdagi SENAN ning pufakchasi
  4  'But what is all this for?' -
     5-kadrdagi SANDRA ning pufakchasi
  5  'There are shark fins over there.' -
     oxirgi kadrdagi SANDRA ning
     pufakchasi

  ⚠ Sandra UCh marta, David va Senan
  bir martadan gapiradi.

pairs.left: 2  He's got marks on his arms.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 2-kadrda Davidning pufakchasi:
"His eyes look like a shark's, and he's got
marks on his arms and legs."

⚠ 4-kadrda Senanning pufakchasi.
⚠ Bu yerda 'must' - HAQIQIY MAJBURIYaT.

pairs.left: 4  But what is all this for?
5  There are shark fins over there.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Oxirgi kadrda Sandraning pufakchasi -
u 'David, do something!' deb murojaat qiladi,
demak gapirayotgan Sandra.

exercises.instructionEn: Read the episode and answer the questions.
exercises.instructionUz: Epizodni o'qing va savollarga javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'LIQ GAP BILAN JAVOB BERISh.

  ⚠ Har javob komiksdagi ANIQ gapga
  asoslanadi.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  'Where EXACTLY are they?'
  = ular aynan qayerda?
  ⚠ 'exactly' savolni ANIQROQ qiladi:
  'Osiyoda' emas, 'Kontu qishlog'ida'
  degan javob kutiladi.


⚠ 'WHY' SAVOLIGA JAVOB:

  'Why does Senan go to the forest?'
  → 'To begin his magic and dream of
     the shark.'

  ⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV ('to' + fe'l)
  ishlatiladi - 'for begin' XATO.
  ⚠ 'Because he wants to ...' ham to'g'ri.

items.question: Where exactly are David and Sandra?
items.answer: They are in the village of Kontu in the South Pacific.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Kirish matnidan.
⚠ 'exactly' - aniq joy nomi kutiladi.

items.question: How does Senan know who they are?
What does Senan ask them to do?
items.answer: He asks them to eat only sweet potatoes and go to sleep early.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to ask sb TO DO sth' - infinitiv bilan.
⚠ 4-kadrdagi buyruqlar.

items.question: Why does Senan go to the forest?
items.answer: To begin his magic and dream of the shark.
items.whyUz:
⚠ MAQSAD uchun INFINITIV: 'TO begin'.
⚠ 5-kadrda Senanning gapidan.

items.prompt: Sandra qayiq ostida nima borligini aytadi?
items.question: What does Sandra say is under the canoe?
items.answer: She says a shark is under the canoe.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Oxirgi kadrda: 'A shark is under the canoe!'
⚠ 'a canoe' - /kəˈnuː/ deb o'qiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the words from the list, then make sentences using the completed phrases.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlarni qo'ying, so'ng tayyor iboralar bilan gap tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
HAMMA IBORA KOMIKSDA BOR.


TO'LIQ RO'YXAT:

  to CALL sharks    - akula chaqirmoq
  SWEET potatoes    - shirin kartoshka
  to GO to sleep    - uxlagani yotmoq
  to ASK questions  - savol bermoq
  to LOOK angry     - jahli chiqqanga
                      o'xshamoq
  to GET ready      - tayyorlanmoq
  COCONUT shells    - kokos qobiqlari
  SHARK fins        - akula qanotlari


⚠ 'TO GO TO SLEEP' va 'TO GO TO BED':

  go to bed = to'shakka yotmoq
  go to sleep = UXLAB QOLMOQ

  ⚠ Ikkalasi ham ARTIKLSIZ.


⚠ 'TO LOOK' + SIFAT:

  'to look angry' = jahli chiqqanga
     o'xshamoq
  ⚠ 'look' dan keyin SIFAT keladi,
  ravish EMAS: 'look angry'
  ('look angrily' - boshqa ma'no).

  ⚠ Xuddi shunday: 'look tired',
  'look happy', 'sound interesting',
  'feel cold'.


⚠ 'TO ASK QUESTIONS':

  ⚠ 'to MAKE questions' - XATO.
  ⚠ 'to ask A question' (birlik) yoki
  'to ask questions' (ko'plik).

KITOBDAGI QUTI.

  'We use MUST + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   true.'
     'This MUST BE her bag. Her purse is
      inside it.'
     (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)

  'We use CAN'T + infinitive WITHOUT TO
   to say that something is logically
   untrue.'
     'The Rover CAN'T BE his. He's got a
      Lancia.'
     (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)


⚠ ENG MUHIM: 'MUST' NING IKKI MA'NOSI

  1) MAJBURIYaT:
     'You must eat only sweet potatoes.'
     = yeyishing KERAK

  2) TAXMIN (aniqlik):
     'Senan must be the older man.'
     = u bo'lsa KERAK

  ⚠ Farqi KONTEKSTdan bilinadi.
  ⚠ Taxmin ma'nosida odatda 'be' fe'li
  bilan keladi: 'must BE'.


⚠ 'CAN'T' - TAXMINNING INKORI:

  ⚠ DIQQAT: taxminni inkor qilish uchun
  'MUSTN'T' EMAS, 'CAN'T' ishlatiladi!

  'It must be him.' (u bo'lsa kerak)
  "It can't be him." (u bo'lishi mumkin
     emas)

  ⚠ "mustn't" = TAQIQ: 'You mustn't
  smoke here.' (chekish MUMKIN EMAS)


⚠ IShONCh DARAJASI:

  must be  - 95% ishonch (ha)
  might be - 50% (balki)
  can't be - 95% ishonch (yo'q)

  ⚠ 'might' 10-unitda o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'INFINITIVE WITHOUT TO':

  = 'to' siz infinitiv.
  ⚠ HAMMA modal fe'ldan keyin shunday:
     must be, can't be, will be,
     should go, might come
  ⚠ 'must to be' - XATO.


=== 'WILL' QUTISI ===

  'We use WILL + infinitive without to
   to make predictions based on what we
   believe or think. We usually use
   WILL with I think, I expect,
   probably etc.'
     'I think it WILL rain today.'

  ⚠ 'will' - TAXMINIY kelajak
  (dalilsiz, fikrga asoslangan).

  ⚠ 'be going to' esa DALILGA
  asoslangan: 'Look at those clouds -
  it's going to rain.'

  ⚠ Bu farq 5-unitda batafsil
  o'rganiladi.


⚠ 'WILL' BILAN KELADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  I think ... will ...
  I expect ... will ...
  ... will probably ...
  I'm sure ... will ...
  Perhaps ... will ...
exercises.bookRef: Coursebook, 25-bet, Expressing Certainty va Will qutilari

points.en: We use must + infinitive without to to say that something is logically true.
points.uz: Biror narsa mantiqan to'g'ri ekanini aytish uchun 'must' + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'infinitive without to' = 'to' siz fe'l.
⚠ 'must to be' - XATO.

points.en: This must be her bag. Her purse is inside it. (= I'm sure the bag is hers.)
points.uz: Bu uning sumkasi bo'lsa kerak. Hamyoni ichida. (= Sumka uniki ekaniga ishonchim komil.)
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'must be' - 95% ishonch.
⚠ 'hers' - EGALIK olmoshi ('her bag' = 'hers').
⚠ 'a purse' - 20-betdagi 16-mashqda ham bor edi.

points.en: We use can't + infinitive without to to say that something is logically untrue.
points.uz: Biror narsa mantiqan noto'g'ri ekanini aytish uchun "can't" + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ DIQQAT: "mustn't" EMAS, "CAN'T"!
⚠ "mustn't" = TAQIQ, taxminning inkori emas.

points.en: The Rover can't be his. He's got a Lancia. (= I'm sure the Rover isn't his.)
points.uz: Rover uniki bo'lishi mumkin emas. Unda Lancia bor. (= Rover uniki emasligiga ishonchim komil.)
points.noteUz:
⚠ Rover va Lancia - avtomobil markalari.
⚠ 'his' - EGALIK olmoshi.

points.en: We use will + infinitive without to to make predictions based on what we believe or think.
points.uz: Ishonchimiz yoki fikrimizga asoslangan taxmin qilish uchun 'will' + 'to' siz infinitiv ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a prediction' = taxmin, bashorat.
⚠ 'to predict' = oldindan aytmoq.

points.en: We usually use will with I think, I expect, probably etc. I think it will rain today.
points.uz: 'will' ni odatda 'I think', 'I expect', 'probably' bilan ishlatamiz. Menimcha, bugun yomg'ir yog'adi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu so'zlar taxminni YUMShATADI.
⚠ 'probably' - 'will' dan KEYIN:
'It will probably rain.'

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts, then make sentences with must or can't, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlar va ko'rsatmalarga qarang, so'ng must yoki can't bilan gap tuzing, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
TO'RTTA SURAT VA JUFTLIK.

  ⚠ Har juftlikda BIRINChI so'z -
  suratdagi narsa (must be),
  IKKINChI so'z - noto'g'ri variant
  (can't be).


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  "It must be a coconut. It can't be a
   pineapple."


SURATLAR:
  1) jigarrang tukli yong'oq →
     coconut (pineapple emas)
  2) tez suzayotgan qayiq →
     speedboat (canoe emas)
  3) sariq, tekis po'stli ildizmeva →
     potato (doughnut emas)
  4) suvdan sakrayotgan sur hayvon,
     uzun tumshuqli → dolphin
     (shark emas)


⚠ 'A DOLPHIN' va 'A SHARK' FARQI:

  dolphin - sutemizuvchi, uzun tumshuq,
     do'stona
  shark - baliq, uchburchak suzgich,
     tishlari ko'rinadi

  ⚠ Hikoyada AKULA bor - shuning uchun
  bu juftlik ataylab tanlangan.


⚠ 'A SPEEDBOAT' va 'A CANOE':

  a speedboat - motorli tez qayiq
  a canoe - eshkakli tor qayiq

  ⚠ Hikoyada CANOE bor.


⚠ ARTIKL ShART:

  'It must be A coconut.'
  ⚠ Sanaladigan ot birlikda - artikl
  HAR DOIM kerak.
exercises.exampleEn: It must be a coconut. It can't be a pineapple.
exercises.exampleUz: Bu kokos yong'og'i bo'lsa kerak. Ananas bo'lishi mumkin emas.
modelAnswers: It must be a coconut. It can't be a pineapple.
It must be a speedboat. It can't be a canoe.
It must be a potato. It can't be a doughnut.
It must be a dolphin. It can't be a shark.
modelAnswersUz: Bu kokos yong'og'i bo'lsa kerak. Ananas bo'lishi mumkin emas.
Bu tezyurar qayiq bo'lsa kerak. Eshkakli qayiq bo'lishi mumkin emas.
Bu kartoshka bo'lsa kerak. Ponchik bo'lishi mumkin emas.
Bu delfin bo'lsa kerak. Akula bo'lishi mumkin emas.

exercises.explanationUz:
MANTIQIY XULOSA ChIQARISh.

  ⚠ Har gapda IKKI qism bor:
  DALIL va XULOSA. Dalil xulosani
  tasdiqlaydi (must) yoki inkor qiladi
  (can't).


TAHLIL:

  1  'They look the same.' (dalil)
     → 'They MUST be twins.' (xulosa)
     ⚠ O'xshashlik egizaklikni TASDIQLAYDI.

  2  "He's got black hair." (dalil)
     → "He CAN'T be from Norway."
     ⚠ Norvegiyaliklar odatda oq-sariq
     sochli (9-betdagi xatda: 'tend to
     be tall, with fair hair').

  3  "She hasn't got one." (dalil)
     → "This car CAN'T be Susan's."
     ⚠ Mashinasi yo'q bo'lsa, bu mashina
     uniki bo'lolmaydi.

  4  'Julie is an excellent student.'
     (dalil)
     → 'She MUST study hard.'
     ⚠ A'lochilik ko'p o'qishni
     TASDIQLAYDI.

  5  "He doesn't like classical music."
     (dalil)
     → "This CD CAN'T be his."


⚠ 4-BANDGA DIQQAT:

  'She MUST STUDY hard.'
  ⚠ Bu yerda 'be' emas, ODDIY FE'L
  ('study') keladi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni 'must' taxmin ma'nosida
  faqat 'be' bilan emas, boshqa
  fe'llar bilan ham kelishi mumkin.


⚠ EGALIK ShAKLI:

  "Susan's" = Syuzanniki
  'his' = uniki
  ⚠ Bunday egalik olmoshidan keyin
  OT TAKRORLANMAYDI.

items.textEn: 1  They look the same. They ___ be twins.
2  He's got black hair. He ___ be from Norway.
items.whyUz:
⚠ Norvegiyaliklar odatda OQ-SARIQ sochli -
9-betdagi xatda: 'tend to be tall, with fair
hair'.
⚠ Qora soch - Norvegiyalik EMASLIGINING dalili.

items.textEn: 3  This car ___ be Susan's. She hasn't got one.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'She HASN'T got one' - mashinasi YO'Q.
⚠ Demak bu mashina uniki BO'LOLMAYDI.
⚠ 'one' = 'a car' (takrorlamaslik uchun).

items.textEn: 4  Julie is an excellent student. She ___ study hard.
items.whyUz:
⚠ A'lochilik - ko'p o'qishning DALILI.
⚠ DIQQAT: bu yerda 'be' emas, ODDIY FE'L
('study') keladi.

items.textEn: 5  This CD ___ be his. He doesn't like classical music.
items.whyUz:
⚠ "He DOESN'T like classical music" - diskning
uniki EMASLIGINING dalili.
⚠ 'his' - egalik olmoshi, keyin ot takrorlanmaydi.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the events into the correct order, then listen and check your answers. Finally, tell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Voqealarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va javoblaringizni tekshiring. Nihoyat, hikoyani so'zlab bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
VOQEALAR KETMA-KETLIGI.

  ⚠ Kitobda 5-band ALLAQAChON '1' deb
  belgilangan: 'Sandra and David reach
  the village of Kontu.'


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Sandra and David reach the village
     of Kontu.  (kitobda BERILGAN)
  2  Senan takes them to his hut.
  3  Senan gives them sweet potatoes to
     eat.
  4  Senan goes to the forest to begin
     his magic.
  5  Mosan curses Senan.
  6  Senan beats the water with coconut
     shells.
  7  Sharks appear.


⚠ QANDAY TEKShIRILADI:

  Komiksdagi kadrlar KETMA-KET -
  har voqeani o'z kadridan toping.

  ⚠ Mosanning la'nati 'NEXT MORNING ON
  THE SHORE' yozuvidan KEYIN - demak
  u o'rmondagi sehrdan KEYIN sodir
  bo'lgan.


⚠ HIKOYaNI SO'ZLAB BERISh:

  KETMA-KETLIK so'zlarini ishlating:
     First, ... - avval
     Then, ... - keyin
     After that, ... - shundan keyin
     Later, ... - keyinroq
     Finally, ... - nihoyat

  ⚠ Zamon: PAST SIMPLE
     reached, took, gave, went, cursed,
     beat, appeared

  ⚠ 'beat' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l:
  beat - beat - beaten (o'tgan zamon
  shakli O'ZGARMAYDI).


⚠ 'TO REACH':

  = yetib bormoq.
  ⚠ PREDLOGSIZ: 'reach the village'
  ('reach TO the village' XATO).


⚠ 'TO APPEAR':

  = paydo bo'lmoq.
  ⚠ Aksi: 'to disappear' = g'oyib bo'lmoq.

pairs.right: Sandra and David reach the village of Kontu.
pairs.rightUz: Sandra va Devid Kontu qishlog'iga yetib boradi.

pairs.right: Senan takes them to his hut.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 3-kadr: 'Come. My hut is this way.'
⚠ 'to take sb TO a place' - predlog 'to'.

pairs.right: Senan gives them sweet potatoes to eat.
pairs.rightUz: Senan ularga yeyish uchun shirin kartoshka beradi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 4-kadr: 'You must eat only sweet potatoes.'
⚠ 'to give sb sth' - ikki to'ldiruvchi.

pairs.right: Senan goes to the forest to begin his magic.
pairs.rightUz: Senan sehrini boshlash uchun o'rmonga boradi.

pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 7-kadr: 'NEXT MORNING ON THE SHORE' -
demak o'rmondagi sehrdan KEYIN.
⚠ Qism nomi ham shu voqeadan: 'The Curse'.

pairs.right: Senan beats the water with coconut shells.
pairs.rightUz: Senan suvni kokos qobiqlari bilan uradi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Oxirgi kadr.
⚠ 'beat' - NOTO'G'RI fe'l: beat - beat - beaten.

⚠ Oxirgi kadr: 'There are shark fins over
there ...'
⚠ 'to appear' = paydo bo'lmoq; aksi

exercises.instructionEn: What do you think will happen in the next episode? Make predictions with will, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Sizningcha, keyingi qismda nima bo'ladi? 'will' bilan taxmin qiling, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
KELAJAK HAQIDA TAXMIN.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  'I think the shark WILL ATTACK them.'


⚠ QOLIP:

  I think + EGA + WILL + ODDIY FE'L

  ⚠ 'will' dan keyin 'to' YO'Q:
  'will attack' ('will to attack' XATO).


⚠ 'WILL' BILAN KELADIGAN SO'ZLAR:

  I think ... will ...
  I expect ... will ...
  ... will probably ...
  I'm sure ... will ...
  Perhaps ... will ...
  Maybe ... will ...

  ⚠ 'probably' - 'will' dan KEYIN:
  'The shark will PROBABLY attack them.'


⚠ INKOR ShAKLI:

  'I don't think the shark will attack
   them.'

  ⚠ DIQQAT: inkor BIRINChI fe'lda
  ('don't think'), ikkinchisida EMAS.
  ⚠ "I think the shark won't attack" -
  grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri, lekin
  TABIIY EMAS.


⚠ NIMA BO'LIShI MUMKIN (taxminlar):

  • Akula qayiqqa hujum qiladi
  • Senan akulani to'xtatadi
  • Mosanning la'nati ta'sir qiladi
  • Yomg'ir yog'adi
  • Sandra yoki David suvga tushib
    ketadi

  ⚠ Keyingi qism nomi 'Bad Magic'
  (46-47-betlar) - bu ham ipuchi.
exercises.exampleEn: I think the shark will attack them.
modelAnswers: I think the shark will attack them.
I expect Senan will stop the shark with his magic.
I think Mosan's curse will bring rain.
Sandra and David will probably be in danger.
I'm sure David will do something to help Sandra.
Perhaps the canoe will turn over.
modelAnswersUz: Menimcha, Senan sehri bilan akulani to'xtatadi.
Sandra va Devid ehtimol xavf ostida qoladi.
Ishonchim komil, Devid Sandraga yordam berish uchun biror narsa qiladi.

patterns.formula: It must be [nima]. It can't be [nima].
patterns.exampleEn: It must be a coconut. It can't be a pineapple.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu kokos yong'og'i bo'lsa kerak. Ananas bo'lishi mumkin emas.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'must be' - 95% ishonch (ha).
⚠ "can't be" - 95% ishonch (yo'q).
⚠ "mustn't be" - XATO! U TAQIQ bildiradi.

patterns.exampleEn: They look the same. They must be twins.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular bir xil ko'rinadi. Ular egizak bo'lsa kerak.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Avval DALIL, keyin XULOSA.
⚠ Dalil xulosani tasdiqlasa 'must',
inkor qilsa "can't".

patterns.exampleEn: I think the shark will attack them.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'will' dan keyin ODDIY fe'l ('to' YO'Q).
⚠ 'I think', 'I expect', 'probably' - taxminni
yumshatadi.

patterns.exampleEn: I don't think the shark will attack them.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ INKOR BIRINChI fe'lda: "don't think".
⚠ "I think ... won't" - grammatik to'g'ri,
lekin tabiiy emas.
